subject: Julius
text: Julius was discovered as an infant by Dark Lord in a cave near the Waterfalls by Glaive.

evidence.quote:
Many years ago, Dark Lord found a baby in a cave at the Waterfalls 
near Glaive. .... That's Julius.

subject: Kain
text: Julius blasts Kain over the edge of the airship with a fireball, causing Kain to fall several screens down into a house in Menos.

evidence.quote:
The fireball knocks Kain over the edge. He holds onto the 
edge...Kain slips and falls down several screens, and he lands in a house in 
Menos.

subject: Amanda
text: Amanda greets Kain while he rests in Menos, but she takes his Pendant and departs the village.

evidence.quote:
Amanda: I'm glad to see you again, my friend.... I came back from 
Glaive after you left there.... Oh, Kain.... I'm sorry.... But I have 
to.......Kain: ..Where am I? .... Pendant!! .... Where is it?! .... I thought 
that it was Amanda talking to me....

subject: Chocobo Egg
text: A boy in Menos states that he saw a chocobo egg in a forest located up north.

evidence.quote:
Boy: We use to see many chocobos around here. I saw an egg in a forest 
up north!

subject: Menos Weapon Shop
text: The weapon shop in Menos sells the Wind spear for 1150GP.

evidence.quote: Wind (spear)    1150GP

subject: Menos Item Shop
text: The item shop in Menos sells X-Cure2 for 160GP, Pure 3 for 30GP, and Moogle3 for 120GP.

evidence.quote:
X-Cure2      160GP
Pure  3       30GP
Moogle3      120GP

subject: Lester
text: Townspeople in Menos state that Amanda's younger brother Lester plays the harp in Jadd at the north end of the desert.

evidence.quote:
Old Man: I used to hear a beautiful sound of harp over in Jadd. Jadd is 
at the north end of the desert....Woman: Amanda's little brother, Lester, is a musician. He's playing 
harp in a town called Jadd.

subject: Book of Ice
text: A resident in Menos reveals that the Book of Ice is hidden somewhere in the desert.

evidence.quote: Mother: The Book of Ice is hidden somewhere in the desert!

subject: Poison Gas
text: Traveling one screen south, one screen east, one screen north, and one screen east from outside Jadd leads to fatal poison gas.

evidence.quote:
From entrance of Jadd, while standing outside Jadd, go south one 
screen then east one screen then go north one screen then go one screen 
east...Kain:  AAARGH! Poison gas!!!

subject: Cave of Oasis
text: Giving a bag of Fang to a boy in Jadd reveals the entrance clue for the Cave of Oasis: palm trees and the number 8.

evidence.quote: Boy: Cave of Oasis? I'll tell you for a bag of Fang!...Boy: Here's the clue. Palm trees.. and 8. Got it?

subject: Jadd Weapon Shop
text: The weapon shop in Jadd sells the Gold shield for 920GP, Gold helmet for 680GP, and Gold armor for 1300GP.

evidence.quote:
Gold (shield)    920GP
Gold (helmet)    680GP
Gold (armor)    1300GP

subject: Jadd Weapon Shop
text: The weapon shop in Jadd buys back X-Cure2 for 80GP, Silver shield for 252GP, Silver helmet for 120GP, and Silver armor for 350GP.

evidence.quote:
X-Cure2           80GP
Silver (shield)  252GP
Silver (helmet)  120GP
Silver (armor)   350GP

subject: Chocobo
text: An egg discovered moving in the forest hatches into a chocobo that follows Kain and joins his journey.

evidence.quote: Kain: ....?? Wow! It's moving!...The egg hatches...Kain: You think I'm your mother? .... Okay. .... Come with me!

subject: Desert Item Shop
text: An item shop in the desert reached from Jadd sells X-Ether for 640GP, Flame 2 for 60GP, Blaze 2 for 240GP, Silence for 100GP, and Pillow for 100GP.

evidence.quote:
From outside Jadd, go south one screen then east one screen then go 
south one screen then go west one screen then go south one screen then 
go west one screen then go north one screen. Item shop...X-Ether     640GP
Flame 2      60GP
Blaze 2     240GP
Silence     100GP
Pillow      100GP

subject: Amanda
text: Amanda explains she traded the Pendant to Davias for Lester who was transformed into a parrot, and partners with Kain to obtain Medusa's tears.

evidence.quote:
Amanda: I'm sorry. I had to bring it to Davias.... That Pendant was to 
exchange for my brother. But.... Davias cursed him and turned him into 
a parrot....! I must get the tears of Medusa to uncurse him!
Kain: .. Amanda.... .... I'll help you.

subject: Cave of Medusa
text: Gold armor is found inside a dungeon room in the Cave of Medusa.

evidence.quote:
(In one of the rooms in the dungeon)
Found Gold(armor).

subject: Cave of Medusa
text: Finding the Magic Book of Ice inside the Cave of Medusa teaches Kain the Ice spell.

evidence.quote: Found the Magic Book of Ice. Learned Ice!

subject: Medusa
text: After Medusa is defeated, Amanda transforms into a Medusa due to a bite and is put down by Kain, who takes a drop of tear from her face.

evidence.quote:
Amanda: I guess Medusa bit me while fighting.... .... One who was 
bitten by Medusa turns to Medusa...Amanda turns into a Medusa. Attack her...Kain took a drop of Tear from Amanda's face.

subject: Lester
text: Kain uses Amanda's tear to cure Lester from Davias's curse, and Lester plays a mystic tune that opens a staircase in the lower right corner.

evidence.quote:
Kain used Amanda, the tears of Amanda....
(The parrot turns into Lester)
Lester was released from Davias's curse...Lester: Thanks. Let's go, Kain!
(A staircase appears in the lower right corner)
Kain: Mystic tune?!
Lester: Yeah.

subject: Davias's Mansion
text: A Were axe is found inside the dungeon of Davias's Mansion.

evidence.quote:
(In the dungeon)
Found Were(Axe).

subject: Davias
text: Davias is defeated at the top of his mansion after revealing that Garuda has flown the Pendant over Mt. Rocks toward Glaive.

evidence.quote:
Davias: HA! You can never defeat me!...Lester: We did it!
Davias: The Pendant is no longer here, my dear....! Garuda is flying 
over Mt. Rocks to Glaive....
Davias fell....

subject: Jadd
text: Lester plays his harp to clear the poison gas and hands Kain the Magic Book of Mute, teaching him the Mute spell.

evidence.quote: Lester: My harp tunes will clear the gas, Kain!...Received the Magic Book of Mute. Learned Mute.

subject: Desert Item Store
text: An item store located one screen east and two screens south of Golem's Cave sells Frost 2 for 320GP.

evidence.quote:
Go east one screen from Golem's cave then go south two screen. Item 
store...Frost  2   320GP

subject: Metal Crab
text: Metal Crab is defeated inside its lair.

evidence.quote:
(Inside Metal Crab's lair)
Defeated Metal Crab!

subject: Weapon Shop
text: A weapon shop sells Opal armor for 3000GP, Opal helmet for 3500GP, and Opal shield for 3900GP.

evidence.quote:
Opal (armor)   3000GP
Opal (helmet)  3500GP
Opal (shield)  3900GP

subject: Cyclops
text: Defeating Cyclops at the end of Golem's Cave reveals a chest containing a Star.

evidence.quote:
(At the end of the cave)
Defeated Cyclops!
(Open chest) 
Found Star!

subject: Golem
text: Defeating Golem two screens north from the cave entrance yields the Magic Book of Lightning to learn Lit.

evidence.quote:
Two screens north from entrance of Golem's cave...Defeated Golem!
Received the Magic Book of Lightning. Learned Lit.

subject: Castle Bridge
text: Going one screen north from the Golem fight, downstairs, and one screen east through a door crosses a bridge that collapses behind Kain.

evidence.quote:
Go north one screen from Golem fight then go down stairs then go east 
one screen and go through the door...The bridge collapses...Kain: I can't go back anymore ....

subject: Chimera
text: Chimera is defeated in a boss battle inside Glaive Castle.

evidence.quote:
(Castle)
(After boss fight)
Defeated Chimera!

subject: Glaive Castle
text: The Blood sword is found inside Glaive Castle.

evidence.quote:
(In the castle)
Found Blood (sword).

subject: Dark Lord
text: Dark Lord is defeated at the top of Glaive Castle, yielding only a fake Pendant while Julius abducts Jena to the Waterfalls.

evidence.quote:
Dark Lord: Looks like you've been a bit stronger. But not enough to 
fight me, boy!...Defeated Dark Lord
Received Pendant...
Kain: .... It's fake! Then, where is the real Pendant?...Must be at the Waterfalls!!

subject: Mana Waterfall
text: Julius has Jena reverse the Mana Waterfall flow and strikes Kain with lightning down a cliff, after which Kain's chocobo carries him into Ish.

evidence.quote:
Julius: I am the last one left of Empire Vandole. I shall receive the 
power of Mana again! Now, Jena! Reverse the Waterfalls!...After the screen flashes, 
the waterfalls reverse flow...Julius shoots Kain with lightning and Kain falls over the cliff...Kain's chocobo walks over and picks him up. The chocobo walks one 
screen to the east and into the town of Ish.

subject: Bogard
text: Kain meets Bogard in Ish, who survived falling from the airship thanks to Sarah but cannot move due to a broken back.

evidence.quote:
Bogard: I was thrown from the ship.... But Sarah picked me up and saved 
me...Sarah: He didn't wanna let you know, but.. He can't move for a while 
for his broken back.

subject: Chocobot
text: Dr. Bowow outfits the chocobo with mechanized legs to create Chocobot, allowing it to cross water.

evidence.quote:
Bowow: Phew..! All done! I mechanized his wounded legs. He's fine now! 
He can even go on water! I named him Chocobot!! How's that?

subject: Excalibur
text: Bogard informs Kain that defeating Julius requires the legendary sword Excalibur and directs him to seek Cibba in Wendel.

evidence.quote:
Bogard: I knew you would do it. Now, listen. It'll be perilous from now 
on. Julius has got the power of Mana already. Only match is the Knight 
with the Legendary Sword.
Kain: Legend.. ....!! The Excalibur?!...Bogard: Somewhere in this world.... Go to Wendel and ask Cibba. He 
knows better.

subject: Northern Pier
text: Dr. Bowow explains to sail east across the sea from the northern pier and head north to Wendel, or head south to reach the Ammonites.

evidence.quote:
Bowow: Go east on the sea from the pier at north. And go north to 
Wendel. ....South is to the Ammonites.

subject: Ish Weapon Shop
text: The weapon shop in Ish sells Flame armor for 5625GP, Flame shield for 4400GP, and Flame Whip for 6300GP.

evidence.quote:
Flame (armor)     5625GP
Flame (shield)    4400GP
Flame (Whip)      6300GP

subject: Lich
text: Defeating the Lich inside Lich Cave rewards the Magic Book of Nuke, teaching Kain the Nuke spell.

evidence.quote:
(Lich Cave) 
Defeated Lich!
Received the Magic Book of Nuke. Learned Nuke!

subject: Cibba
text: A girl in Wendel states that Cibba went to Lorim after it was attacked by monsters, situated south of the Snowfield over the southern sea.

evidence.quote:
Girl: Lorim was attacked by many monsters. Cibba went there. Lorim is 
south of the Snowfield over the southern sea.
